name: pdf.js
readme_excerpt: PDF.js PDF.js is a Portable Document Format (PDF) viewer that is built with HTML5. PDF.js is community-driven and supported by Mozilla. Our goal is to create a general-purpose, web standards-based platform for parsing and rendering PDFs. Contributing PDF.js is an open source project and always looking for more contributors.
